about: Ticket merge (git step 2, design D8; workspace-addons/sync merge.py). tickets: merge_ticket(base, upstream=a, mine=b, now, person=VERIFIER) must give `expect` (null = cannot merge, caller pauses) and the SAME result with a and b swapped. counter: merge_counter(base, a, b, keys). key_clash: renumber_key_clashes(tickets, counter, now, held) -> {changed, counter} (null = malformed, caller pauses; held = ids that held the key locally, they keep it). VERIFIER (every vector; the real one is humanproof.wont_verifier, the receiving core's own wontdo1 MAC, human-proof.md 'Synced won't do'): person(step, ticket id) is true exactly when step.wont_mac == "valid:" + ticket id + ":" + step id; the text of `by` is never looked at; no verifier = nobody is a person. `rule` = section of the design (4.1 rules 2-10, D8 = clock/loser/old_keys).
